A sensor is an input. What does every input talk to?

A tablet is a team of parts. Inputs take things in: the touch sensor, the camera, the microphone. Outputs give things out: the screen, the speaker. The processor thinks, storage remembers, and the battery powers it all.

Fixed! A careful fixer could do it in {n} min.
Fixers do not guess. They build a chain of yes/no questions, cheapest first, and follow it. When a part might be broken, they swap it for one that works: a swap test shows which part is at fault.

Hardware is what you can touch: the screen, the keyboard, the battery, the chips. Software is the instructions that tell the hardware what to do: apps and programs. Every task needs both.
